latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of jetson-tools.

- Provides tools for NVIDIA Jetson boards: system monitoring, performance analysis, and GPU status.
- Includes commands for real-time monitoring, device info, GPU/memory/CPU stats, and temperature checks.
- Displays JetPack version information.
- Requires tegrastats and jetson_release dependencies.
